name: TV DIABLO Windows
note: v3356: v3353 shipped a law whose whole subject is CI-versus-Mac divergence, and one of its own assertions was venue-dependent. MEASURED on the v3354 agent-tests run: AssertionError 1 != 0, a class that exists in tv/ could not be simulated (exit 1). The case drives ci_sim against TestAnExaminedPanelIsNotAnUnreadOne to prove the SEARCH widened past test_control, and then asserted exit 0 - which asks whether the CLASS PASSES, a different fact from whether the search REACHED it and the only one this case is about. That class is one of the 20 gates failing on a GitHub runner, so ci_sim exits 1 there and says, correctly, that the tests ran and failed. It passes on his Mac only because the class passes on his Mac, which is regression-guard section 3 exactly: a test that needs his machine is a test that runs nowhere else, committed inside the version written about that divergence. The assertion now asks the question the case was always about - exit is NOT 2 and the output does NOT say it could not LOAD - alongside the two checks already there, the module it actually loaded and that something Ran. Exit 2 means UNKNOWN, the name could not be loaded; exit 1 means ran-and-failed, which is venue-dependent and not this law subject. The red-proofs still discriminate: narrowing the search back to test_control makes the class unloadable, which is exit 2 plus the could-not-LOAD line, and all three PROVE. ⚠ The related finding from the same run is already shipped: swallow_ratchet was one of those 20 and v3355 closed it, taking Routine M from 13 consecutive failures to green. The other 18 are the standing unattributed pool. HEART: this version changes ONE assertion inside one law and adds no surface, no lane and no store - there is nothing new to supervise, and the law it repairs is itself the supervision. 478 gates, 5 cases, 3 red-proofs PROVEN.
